action.action-desc: Mr. Newhouse introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Agriculture, and in addition to the Committees on Foreign Affairs, Energy and Commerce, and Financial Services, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To amend the Defense Production Act of 1950 and the Agricultural Foreign Investment Disclosure Act of 1978 with respect to foreign investments in United States agriculture.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Protecting American Agriculture from Foreign Adversaries Act of 2024.

section.header: Inclusion of Secretary of Agriculture on Committee on Foreign Investment in United States and notification requirement for particular covered transaction

subsection.text: Section 721(k) of the Defense Production Act of 1950 (50 U.S.C. 4565(k)) is amended by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.header: Inclusion of the secretary of agriculture
paragraph.text: For purposes of paragraph (2)(J), the Secretary of Agriculture shall be a member of the Committee with respect to a covered transaction that involves—

subsection.header: Notification of a particular covered transaction
subsection.text: The Agricultural Foreign Investment Disclosure Act of 1978 (7 U.S.C. 3501, et seq.) is amended—

paragraph.text: in section 2, by adding at the end the following:

The Secretary shall, to the maximum extent practicable, notify the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States with respect to each covered transaction relating to agricultural land that the Secretary has reason to believe, based on information received from or in cooperation with the intelligence community—

subparagraph.text: may pose a risk to the national security of the United States; and
requires a report to be submitted to the Secretary of Agriculture under subsection (a).

paragraph.text: Under paragraph (1), the Secretary shall prioritize notification in the case of a covered transaction where a foreign country of concern or a foreign entity of concern acquires or transfers an interest in agricultural land other than a security interest.

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (6), by striking the period at the end and inserting a semicolon; and
by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.text: the term covered transaction has the meaning given such term in section 721(a) of the Defense Production Act of 1950 (50 U.S.C. 4565(a));
the terms foreign country of concern and foreign entity of concern have the meanings given such terms in section 10612(a) of the CHIPS Act of 2022 (42 U.S.C. 19221(a)), respectively; and
the term intelligence community has the meaning given such term in section 3 of the National Security Act of 1947 (50 U.S.C. 3003).
